{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{refimprove|date=February 2024}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2015–16 |team=Tulsa Golden Hurricane |image=Tulsa Golden Hurricane wordmark.svg |image_size=175 |conference=American Athletic Conference |division= |short_conf=The American |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=20–12 |conf_record=12–6 |head_coach=[[Frank Haith]] |hc_year = 2nd |asst_coach1=[[Dennis Felton]] |asst_coach2=Michael Schwartz |asst_coach3=[[Shea Seals]] |stadium=[[Reynolds Center]] |champion= |bowl=[[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result= First Four }} {{2015–16 American Athletic Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2015–16 Tulsa Golden Hurricane men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Tulsa]] during the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Golden Hurricane, led by second year head coach [[Frank Haith]], played their home games at the [[Reynolds Center]] and were members of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 20–12, 12–6 in The American play to finish in a three-way tie for third place. They lost in the quarterfinals of [[2016 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|The American Athletic tournament]] to [[2015–16 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the First Four to [[2015–16 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]].{{cite news|url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/university-michigan/wolverines/2016/03/16/michigan-67-tulsa-62-wolverines-advance-ncaa-tournament/81895348/|title=Michigan 67, Tulsa 62: Wolverines advance in NCAA tournament|first=Mark|last=Snyder|work=[[Detroit Free Press]]|date=March 16, 2016|access-date=February 4, 2024}} ==Previous season== The [[2014–15 Tulsa Golden Hurricane men's basketball team|Golden Hurricane]] finished the season 23–11, 14–4 in American Athletic play to finish in second place. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2015 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|American Athletic tournament]] where they lost to UConn. They were invited to the [[2015 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated William & Mary in the first round before losing in the second round to Murray State. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
